verdict.rationale: The organization plugin documents assigning roles and permissions scoped to organizations and teams, and the homepage advertises built-in "access control". This gives org-scoped, permission-level authorization somewhat beyond flat global roles. However, the evidence describes RBAC only, with no resource-level, relationship-based (ReBAC) or policy-based authorization model. missing for 10: per-resource permission checks, relationship/ReBAC or policy (ABAC) authorization documentation, custom permission statement depth, independent hands-on corroboration.
